title: October 1842: William Grove’s letter to Faraday Describing a Fuel Cell
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.locator: Grove’s gas battery and October 1842 letter
passages.note: APS reproduces an excerpt of Grove’s 1842 letter reporting a completed gas voltaic battery using hydrogen and oxygen; its account distinguishes this from his separate acid-based Grove cell.
